title: Answer: free will is a kind of conscious decision algorithm, compatible with determinism

statements.text: In the global workspace theory, an action is voluntary when higher-level circuits control its onset and realization, so it can be easily changed or withheld. Exercising free will is one kind of voluntary decision: setting a goal and choosing a course of action by examining alternatives one after another and evaluating their outcomes internally. Free will is thus a property of a decision algorithm at the cognitive level, not at the neural level, and a deterministic physical system can have it if it can represent a goal and estimate the outcomes of its actions before acting.
statements.scope: the 2001 workspace framework of Dehaene and Naccache, section 6.1 on voluntary action and free will

sources.quote: involves the setting of a goal and the selection of a course of action through the serial examination of various alternatives and the internal evaluation of their possible outcomes.
